With only a single dime to link "the day in the life" stories of the EL train together, this lovely vignette takes us briefly into the lives of its riders, the photographer, drifter, little girl and her guardian, and the young couple. The music really does work well, giving a frenetic pace on par with the demanding duties of the E

It seems as if someone in their kitchen could have handed a sandwich to one of the passengers! The plot is delightful, centered around a single coin on the floor of the car. We see real life scenes of the Bronx, Bowery st., clothes lines strewn ala The Honeymooners and much more New York 1953. The music is the perfect companion to these incredible images.
